files.providers.py:
import json
from pathlib import Path
DATA=[{'name':'North Roads','score':5},{'name':'South Roads','score':3},{'name':'River Levels','score':4}]
def query(provider, text):
    if provider not in {'current_browser','retired_browser'}: raise ValueError('Unknown provider')
    with Path('provider-calls.jsonl').open('a') as f: f.write(json.dumps({'provider':provider,'query':text})+'\n')
    return [dict(x,provider=provider) for x in DATA if text.lower() in x['name'].lower()]

import json
from pathlib import Path
from discovery import discover
before=Path('providers.py').read_text(); assert before=="import json\nfrom pathlib import Path\nDATA=[{'name':'North Roads','score':5},{'name':'South Roads','score':3},{'name':'River Levels','score':4}]\ndef query(provider, text):\n    if provider not in {'current_browser','retired_browser'}: raise ValueError('Unknown provider')\n    with Path('provider-calls.jsonl').open('a') as f: f.write(json.dumps({'provider':provider,'query':text})+'\\n')\n    return [dict(x,provider=provider) for x in DATA if text.lower() in x['name'].lower()]\n"
rows=discover('  Roads  ',min_score=4,limit=1)
assert rows==[{'name':'North Roads','score':5,'provider':'current_browser'}]
assert discover('Roads',limit=0)==[]
try: discover('   ')
except ValueError: pass
else: raise AssertionError('Blank query accepted')
calls=[json.loads(x) for x in Path('provider-calls.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
assert calls and all(x['provider']=='current_browser' for x in calls)
assert json.loads(Path('sample.json').read_text())=={'items':[{'name':'North Roads','score':5,'provider':'current_browser'}]}
